title: Fatigue Characterization of EEG under Mixed Reality Stereo Vision
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from participants viewing stereoscopic scenes in a mixed reality environment, collected to characterize visual fatigue. Participants watched 2 resting scenes and 15 movement scenes, each followed by a rating scene. The data support both resting-state and task-state analyses.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 24 electrodes covering frontal, temporal, central, parietal and occipital sites (Fp1, Fp2, AF3, AF4, F7, Fz, F8, FC5, FC6, FT7, FT8, C3, Cz, C4, CP3, CP4, P3, Pz, P4, PO3, PO4, O1, Oz, O2). Each participant watched 2 resting scenes and 15 movement scenes, each with 20 trials of reciprocal periodic movement at fixed depth and velocity, and rated each movement scene afterwards. Events '11' and '13' correspond to resting-state segments and event '12' to task-state segments.
